notes.title: Bog Busters Demo is Live – Play Now and Share Your Feedback! 🚜🔥
notes.notes:
Hey, Busters!
The wait is over - the Bog Busters demo is officially live on Steam! 🎉 Now’s your chance to dive into the mud, test your survival skills, and experience the thrill of off-road adventure firsthand. 🚜💨

In this demo, you’ll explore treacherous terrain, push your vehicle to its limits, and navigate the wild like a true survivalist. Whether you're racing through the bogs, upgrading your ride, or tracking animals, every choice matters in this unpredictable world.

But this is just the beginning! We need your feedback to shape the best possible game. Tell us what you love, what could be improved, and what features you’d like to see. Your insights will help us fine-tune mechanics, balance gameplay, and create the ultimate off-road survival experience.
So, what are you waiting for? Download the demo, start your journey, and let us know what you think! Drop your feedback in the Steam discussions or join our community - we’re listening! 🗣️🔥

See you in the bogs, Busters! 🌿💪

notes.title: Title: Bog Busters Demo is Coming Soon – We Need Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hey, Busters!

Big news – the Bog Busters demo is on its way, and soon, you’ll be able to jump into the action! 

In this early version, you’ll get a taste of the muddy, wild world of Bog Busters, where every choice matters. Race through rough terrain, upgrade your vehicle, track animals, and survive the unpredictable wilderness. The adventure is yours to shape!

But here’s the deal – this is just the beginning. We need your feedback to make Bog Busters the best it can be! Your thoughts on gameplay, mechanics, balance, and overall experience will help us refine and improve everything before the full release.

We want to hear it all - what you love, what needs tweaking, and what you’d like to see next. Your voice will directly impact the development and help us create the ultimate off-road survival game.

So get ready to rev your engines and dive in! More details on the release date coming soon. We can’t wait to hear what you think!
